name: Atalaya Mining Copper, S.A.
research_rationale: Q3/YTD RNS confirms record EBITDA and €342m net cash, supporting the buy screen; Tharsis cash use, cost pressure and the unresolved FCF definition gap keep conviction at accumulate rather than full Buy.

weekly_updates.summary:
12 Nov Q3/YTD 2026 RNS: record quarterly and nine-month EBITDA; net cash €342m at 30 Sep; FY copper output still expected at the low end of guidance.  
11 Nov Tharsis acquisition closed for €125m total (€75m cash on completion, €50m deferred within 12 months), funded from existing cash per filing.  
Quantitative screen remains buy with accumulate timing; filing vs screen TTM FCF basis mismatch unchanged in snapshot.

No material change since the 12–17 Nov Q3/YTD RNS and Tharsis closing covered in the prior refresh.  
The news batch since the last verdict run returned no new articles; filings show only routine 20 Nov director declaration and major-holdings TR-1.  
Buy screen remains stable with accumulate timing; filing vs screen TTM FCF basis mismatch unchanged.
